messages:
sam: FYI I'm seeing steady memory growth on prod-rt when longctx workloads run with continuous batching on. KV cache size climbs and doesn't reclaim.

anita: ugh. any repro? logs?

sam: repro + profiler attached. Repro command:
```
./bench/contbatch_kv_repro --seq 8192 --clients 48 --mode=longctx
```
Profiles show repeated small fragments that never coalesce; merge heuristics skip due to seq mismatch. sample perf counters:
```
kv_frag_allocs: 1.24M
kv_frag_reclaims: 18k
contbatch_merge_failures: 23k
headwedge_events: 7.2k
```

lee: can you paste the flamegraph link?

sam: https://perf.company/redwood/fg/1744001234 (flamegraph shows hot loop in kv_slot_touch + batch_merge_check)

perf-bot: Snapshot created: snapshot://perf/1744001234

anita: hypothesis: when batches with long prefixes merge we create fragmented KV pages; eviction sees many small life-lived fragments so pager thrashes. head-of-line when one big request blocks others waiting for KV merge.

dmitri: I ran a quick patch disabling the 'prefer-merge-on-length' heuristic. mem growth stabilizes at ~1.2GB vs 2.8GB. micro numbers:
```
before: 2.8GB steady after 30m
after: 1.2GB steady after 30m
```

sam: nice. what's the perf regression cost for throughput/latency?

dmitri: < 3% P50 latency regression, throughput unchanged. add-on cost: slightly higher token work due to fewer merges.

anita: sounds like we should tune merge heuristic: only merge if target batch's prefix-share > 0.8 OR fragment_size > 64KB. otherwise schedule as separate batches to avoid headwedge.

lee: +1. can also try opportunistic asynchronous merge: let one thread perform merge while others continue with fallback KV reads.

sam: created a short repro gist with steps and flamegraph. putting on perf triage for tomorrow. @anita can you own the heuristic tweak?

anita: taking it. will run ablation tests and add guard flags in config.

perf-bot: Issue created: INF-1291 "contbatch merge heuristic -> avoid h-o-l blocking for longctx" assigned to anita

sam: thanks. temporary mitigation: set CONTBATCH_MAX_MERGE=65536 on affected clusters.

dmitri: deploying to canary with that env now.

dmitri: deploy-bot: Canary rollout to prod-rt/canary started :rocket:

dmitri: canary mem profile already shows no growth after 20m

lee: let's also add kv metrics: kv_frag_count, kv_small_frag_ratio, contbatch_merge_fail_rate to dashboards.

anita: will add dash tiles + alert on contbatch_merge_fail_rate > 100/min

sam: awesome. follow-up: schedule a longer soak to ensure no regressions. closing for now :thumbsup:
